snippet.title: Alentejo: The Tinto & The Ugly – Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
It’s time to return to the Old Alentejo. Releasing October 25, 2025.
In this 19th-century European Open World RPG western for the Game Boy and PC, join Gildo, Dolores, and Pepe as they fight against Baron Tinto’s oppressive laws. Cross the Iberian border, explore new lands, and face new allies… and enemies.

Stay tuned to our socials and follow us on itch.io to get the latest news and updates! https://loadingstudios.itch.io/
